chunks: And to Allah belong the best names, so call Him by them; and leave those who act profanely towards His names: They will be retributed for their deeds.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to call Allah by His best names?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is foundational for understanding the divine attributes, distinguishing between Allah's essential names and His actions, while cautioning against the distortions of the Mu'tazilites and others. It serves as a bridge between theological affirmation (Tawhid) and practical devotion, urging believers to call upon God with the specific names that reflect His mercy and majesty, such as Ar-Rahman or Al-Malik. The command to 'leave' those who distort implies both physical separation from their gatherings and intellectual rejection of their erroneous interpretations.
